 Pump.fun: Holder Rewards launch replaces Cashback mode - 12 Sep 2026
 Less than 1 min read 
 PUMPUSD 
 Pump.fun has launched Holder Rewards tokens that distribute platform trading fees pro-rata to eligible holders several times per hour. Alongside the release, Cashback mode is removed as a launch option. Existing Cashback and Creator Fee tokens can apply to switch to the new mechanism, and the change is irreversible once made. 
 The fee redistribution creates a recurring holding incentive, since eligible holders receive a pro-rata share of trading fees paid out several times per hour. For $PUMP-quoted pairs, rewards are distributed in $PUMP itself, adding a direct demand channel tied to platform activity. Investors may reposition toward PUMP as a quote asset and toward reward-eligible tokens as adoption develops. The irreversible nature of the switch means token creators who migrate cannot return to the prior fee models.
